films.title: Scope and fire — controlled gameplay
films.notice: Controlled demonstration using the real battle simulation and live HUD. Vehicle positions, target health, movement and scope are staged; firing includes a 0.20-second simulation step. Silent. Encoded frame rate is not a gameplay performance measurement.

review.notes: All 124 final daylight overview and settlement views inspected across 31 maps by root, layout_audit and frontage; native close-ups used where needed. Review covers sampled road/settlement placement and visible terrain transitions. Existing film batches retain their original provenance.

delta.notes: Connected causeways and bank-side roads remain clear. Village frontage sits beside the corridors in all four views.

badlands.notes: Workshop frontage follows the hauling routes, with clear junctions and coherent canyon approaches.

monsoon.notes: The dry-bank village and crossing form a connected route; reciprocal views show clear frontage without a new cut wall.

airfield.notes: Service buildings follow the runway access spine; side roads meet the settlement coherently and visible buildings clear the corridors.

whiteout.notes: The revised approach avoids the former triangular detour. Buildings remain beside the compact service crossroads and lake shore.

orchard.notes: Curved approaches connect to the village and orchard lanes; reciprocal views show distinct parcels and clear junctions.

longleaf.notes: The logging settlement follows the gentle road bend, with yard buildings set back and visible access preserved.

mangrove.notes: The village routes meet on dry ground, with clear roadside parcels. Lake margins and route connectivity remain coherent.

saltwind.notes: The market T and coastal through-road form a coherent village layout; buildings sit inland and the natural coastline remains continuous.

reservoir.notes: Village frontage follows the lake-side route and its actual junction; the road remains clear between the buildings and shoreline.

mars.notes: Specialist habitat placements retain the authored service crossroads and canyon routes. No new ordinary-building placement intrusion is visible; existing steep canyon cuts remain intentional.

verdant.notes: Overview and plan retain the protected rural crossroads layout with dispersed farm plots and continuous approaches. Reciprocal street views show buildings seated beside the road and no visible road-edge wall or frontage overlap. Windmill partially occludes one near corner, with that parcel also visible in plan.

desert.notes: Overview and plan confirm the mesa-foot bypass and removal of the previously rejected narrow sawtooth fill walls. New banks merge into surrounding foothills while the central mesa silhouette and stratified natural face remain distinct. Both reciprocal street views show continuous road surfaces through the village, with adobe fronts and courtyard walls grounded; no abrupt raised road terrace visible.

winter.notes: Overview and native plan show the main route, service loops and frozen lakes separated cleanly; no road crosses a lake sheet or raised road wall is visible. The existing angular western service alignment remains authored. North view confirms snow-supported building frontage. South view is partially obscured by conifers, so nearby parcels were also checked in the unobscured native plan.

urban.notes: Overview and plan show coherent orthogonal street blocks, continuous intersections, and building rows set back from the paved carriageways. Reciprocal street views confirm door-facing facades, connected sidewalks and grounded street corners; no building/road overlap or terrain bank discontinuity visible.

autumn.notes: Overview and plan show a continuous rural crossroads and coherent bridge approach near the river. Church, barns and cottages form readable road frontage with open roadside clearances. Both reciprocal street views show supported building bases and continuous shoulder grades through the village; no isolated elevated road section visible.

coastal.notes: Overview and native plan show the road ending in a sandy turning court before the natural shoreline. The court remains dry and does not extend pavement into the bay. Both street views show the lighthouse and cottages grounded beside continuous pale roads; the shoreward terminal is better resolved in the native plan than from the low camera.

steppe.notes: Overview and plan show a coherent small railway/service settlement with roads joining the station area and the long rail alignment remaining distinct. Reciprocal views show grounded sheds, service buildings and storage parcels with clear road space. Rail and station structures retain their intentional specialist layout.

railyard.notes: Overview and plan show the intentional parallel rail grid and orthogonal service streets with industrial buildings beside them. Reciprocal views show supported warehouses, containers and service roads. Short broken walls across portions of the yard are retained authored battlefield cover; they are not treated as a road-frontage regression.

frontier.notes: Overview and plan show gently curving country roads meeting at a clear rural crossroads, with dispersed buildings facing accessible frontage. Both reciprocal street views show supported barns/cottages and continuous road shoulders over the visible rolling terrain; no disconnected corner or artificial fill wall visible.

fjord.notes: Overview and plan show the coastal settlement roads continuing through the hills toward the harbor, with buildings aligned along the main route. Native north street view confirms barn/cabin bases meet the ground and the road through the junction remains continuous. South view confirms supported hillside parcels; its low angle hides some road length, which is visible in plan.

alpine.notes: Overview: the cabin row follows the dry road east of the frozen lake; no building visibly overlaps the carriageway. Village plan: the diagonal approach and northern crossing stay continuous across the snowy terrain; roadside houses retain visible verges. Street north: foreground porch is on the roadside plot and the road remains open; the lake occupies most of the opposite side. Street south: the low view confirms a clear shore-side approach, but snow relief hides some distant foundations.

caldera.notes: Overview: industrial buildings occupy the rail/road benches with visible circulation space between them. Village plan: the curved road connects both yard areas without a visible building conflict. Street north: the foreground house sits beside the bend rather than in its path; road surface remains continuous. Street south: crossing and factory access remain open. Dark ground limits foundation-detail assessment.

foundry.notes: Overview: the main road and connecting factory lanes remain uninterrupted through the industrial complex. Village plan: warehouses and container groups are offset from the crossing; no evident new footprint intrusion. Street north: crossing is visible and clear; factory entrances have access from the adjacent lane. Street south: roadside warehouse fronts the access lane with rail corridors beyond. Existing rail undulation is outside this change.

ruinspires.notes: Overview: tall landmarks remain separated from the avenue and the rowhouse grid. Village plan: connected rectangular streets remain open at every visible junction. Street north: the close rowhouse has a dark lower-wall/ground opening on its right face; this was also present in the previous baseline and is not evidence of a new placement regression. Street south: lower-rise and tower districts remain connected; open blocks preserve turning space.

blackglass.notes: Overview: the tower-lined central avenue remains continuous with diagonal residential feeders. Village plan: angular outer roads connect cleanly to the main axis and keep building footprints beside the road. Street north: the avenue is visibly open between the towers, scaffold frontage and roadside structures. Street south: local terrain rolls beside the building line without an evident new abrupt road shoulder. Backlighting limits base detail.

titan_gorge.notes: Overview: roads connect the canyon benches and industrial buildings remain on adjoining dry plots. Village plan: the central saddle crossing is connected and clear; factory buildings do not occupy the visible junctions. Street north: the left road climb remains steep-looking but continuous; the compound sits on the separate bench. Street south: the factory entrance faces the open lane. The steep saddle appearance matches the previous capture rather than a new road separation.

skybridge.notes: Overview: the straight elevated road spine remains continuous beside the basin. Village plan: tower and industrial footprints leave the spine/crossings open; lake water does not cut the drivable route. Street north: bank-side building groups remain separated from the road and water. Street south: the road continues uphill past the framework structure without an evident building overlap; existing rail styling is not assessed as a new regression.

oasis.notes: Overview: the caravan road stays on dry ground beside the oasis, with settlement buildings east of the water. Village plan, also inspected native: rounded bends form a clear central junction. The repositioned ordinary adobe and later ruin occupy distinct plots; neither blocks the visible roads. Authored compound walls remain close to their lanes. Street north, also inspected native: market stalls and roadside buildings leave the curved passage open; fronts and shadows meet the ground without a new obvious separation. Street south: the low village buildings and compound accesses sit beside the gently rolling road. The terrain surface has strong sand patterns, which do not indicate a road geometry gap.

polders.notes: Overview: the curved village roads stay connected with adjoining house plots and clear crossings. Village plan: both principal junctions remain clear, and shoulders blend into the hillside rather than appearing as isolated slabs. Street north, also inspected native: the close porch and raised granary are off the carriageway; no new building/road overlap is visible. The previously stippled cloud undersides are noticeably smoother. Street south: the approach follows the slope continuously into the village. Distant foundations are partly hidden by relief.

copper_mesa.notes: Overview: the principal S-bend follows the terrain through the industrial village with a continuous driving surface. Village plan: factory plots, container yards and utility structures sit beside connected curved access roads; visible junctions are clear. Street north: yard buildings have clear circulation space between the road and industrial frontage. Street south, also inspected native: workshops and the container structure are outside the road surface, with continuous access into the yard. No new floating foundation or abrupt shoulder break is evident in this view.

review.notes: Personal inspection of final captures at the receipt's source state. Complete boundary and liquid-shore coverage at the authored capture seed; not all possible seeds or camera positions. Reviewed 31 masters, 558 boundary frames, 546 shoreline frames, 21 sampled video frames and 18 posters. Films are staged, silent, fixed-step exports; sampling does not certify every video frame or live gameplay frame pacing.

verdant.notes: Inspected master and all 18 edge/corner/whole views. Turf, exposed rock and road approaches remain continuous through the boundary; distant forest and ridges share the ground tone, with gradual atmospheric depth.

desert.notes: Inspected master and 18 boundary views. Dune/rock layers remain continuous across corners and road exits; sand coloration carries through the outer ridges without a separate palette band.

winter.notes: Inspected master (including frozen lake banks) and 18 boundary views. Snow, dark rock exposures, ridges and the road exits join continuously; no exposed skirt, square lip or mismatched outer lighting.

urban.notes: Inspected master and 18 boundary views. Paved ground, turf and road approaches carry into the wooded outskirts; no visible square ground join or abrupt lighting change.

coastal.notes: Inspected master, all 18 boundary views and all 110 shoreline views. Three unequal coves retain headlands and consistent beach contact; extended shores bend smoothly into the sea apron without exposed dry seabed triangles or a square join.

autumn.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and 18 shoreline views. River, bridge banks and small pond retain irregular curved contours; wooded hill textures and rock exposures continue across corners without a separate ground band.

steppe.notes: Inspected master and 18 boundary views. Dry grass, brown worn ground and small rock folds retain consistent scale and lighting into the outer woodland and low hills; no surface lip at the sampled joins.

railyard.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Industrial terrain, paving and green outskirts carry the same wet overcast lighting into the distant hills; sampled road exits are seated with no exposed boundary skirt.

frontier.notes: Inspected master and 18 boundary views. Mixed forest, turf and craggy slopes continue beyond the village without a sharp material or height discontinuity at edges/corners.

fjord.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary views and all 213 shoreline views. Rounded inlet heads and narrow dividing headlands meet the water continuously; both outward channels retain shore tangents, fine contact foam and consistent ground shading. Far apron is finite, outside normal gameplay.

badlands.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Layered unequal canyon walls, benches and side washes extend into the outer landscape; canyon mouths remain open and graded, with no old straight enclosing dam or visible material swap.

alpine.notes: Inspected master, frozen lake contour and all 18 boundary views. Snow/rock folds carry into the surrounding alpine cliffs and forest with consistent material scale and no exposed map skirt.

delta.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary views and all 14 river views. Irregular river margins meet the banks continuously; road causeways retain their deliberately straight engineered edges. Tropical ground and forest tone continue through the outer hills.

monsoon.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and 20 shoreline views. Muddy channels, road crossings and enclosed pools retain continuous banks and consistent water contact; wet ground and forest continue into the outer terrain under the same overcast lighting.

saltwind.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and all 107 shore views. Bay lobes and the small inner cove retain smooth joins; the beach continues through both border crossings into the offshore coast without grid cuts, exposed seabed or lighting seams.

orchard.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Orchard slopes, rock folds and grass remain continuous into surrounding forest and mountain faces; no bright boundary strip or disconnected ground.

longleaf.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Forest, green rock folds and worn ground continue into the surrounding hills without a height or material lip at the sampled edges and corners.

whiteout.notes: Inspected master, frozen lake margins and all 18 boundary views. Snow coverage, exposed rock and terrain folds continue into the outer mountains; no raised map rim or material cut at the sampled edges.

blackglass.notes: Inspected master and 18 boundary views. Rock, woodland and brown ground share continuous slopes and lighting beyond the city; no abrupt square edge or separately colored outer terrain.

caldera.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Dark volcanic ground and rock continue up the surrounding ridges under consistent lighting; sampled joins and forest bases remain seated with no detached strip.

ruinspires.notes: Inspected master and 18 boundary views. Grass, rock faces and tree-covered slopes blend into outer hills with shared material scale and lighting; city road exits remain grounded without a visible mesh lip.

foundry.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Industrial grass, paving and road approaches continue through wooded outskirts and distant hills; no separate ground palette or exposed boundary skirt.

titan_gorge.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Sandstone bands and sand continue from the playable slopes to the outer mesas; the sampled joins have no height lip or abrupt shading swap.

skybridge.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and all 9 lake views. Irregular lake contours and the causeway contacts remain closed and continuous; sandstone ground carries through the outer mesa terrain without a map-edge material seam.

polders.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and all 14 shoreline views. Pond lobes and narrow drains retain continuous brown/grass banks without water spikes or openings; low grassy folds and scattered rocks carry out of the map with matching materials.

copper_mesa.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Sand, exposed strata and road cuts carry through the outer mesas with consistent shading; no open join, square lip or detached surface band.

airfield.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Grass and worn ground continue around the runway into forested hills; road exits and rock exposures are joined without a height step or sudden material change.

oasis.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and all 6 lake views. Sandy lake contour has rounded natural lobes and uninterrupted bank contact; sand texture, rock exposures and hills continue through the border without a visible material seam.

mangrove.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and all 24 shoreline views. Branching muddy channels, small pools and causeways have continuous banks and no water wedges at their junctions; green terrain and forest shading continue beyond the map.

reservoir.notes: Inspected master, 18 boundary and all 11 lake views. Inlets, broad shoreline lobes and pump-house edge remain connected with consistent foam contact; grass and rock slopes carry into the outer mountain forest without a material cut. Also inspected all 21 sampled film frames (seven per six-second Day/Sunset/Night film) and all 18 clean/branded posters. Tank and barrel stay framed; wake builds, spreads and fades without a fixed rectangular contact patch. Night is intentionally dark.

mars.notes: Inspected master and all 18 boundary views. Red regolith and rock strata continue into the outer terrain with matching surface response; sampled road approaches and corners have no detached map skirt.

review.notes: All nine clean compositions and the nine branded poster contact sheet reviewed. Individual scene motion sheets and all 26 one-second trailer samples reviewed with filter reinitialization disabled (end-card color metadata otherwise resets the contact-sheet filter). Full 780-frame decode passed. Titles are legible without overlap, planned cuts and desert fire/knockout appear in samples; coast portrait no longer intersects the foreground tree. Existing terrain texture patterns and cropped roadside wreck remain visible; no claim of flawless renderer output or continuous human playback.
review.audioNotes: Technical review only: complete AAC decode succeeded; 26-second original synthesized soundtrack, mean -26.5 dBFS and peak -3.6 dBFS without clipping. Fire/impact cues at9.867,11.967,13.600,14.067,14.200 seconds match authored visual-event times after scene offsets. Audio listening unavailable in this environment; no subjective listening claim.

steel-pursuit.notes: Low escort, front-side pass and overhead follow keep both tanks on the road. Foreground poles pass through the shot; portrait/square retain a cropped roadside wreck.

desert-crossfire.notes: Sunset engagement retains both vehicle tracks and three camera segments. Return fire and knockout are visible; high-contrast ground material is an existing renderer feature.

coast-recon.notes: Clear coastal patrol and low tank silhouette with sea in the first segment; full tank remains visible in portrait. Final overhead moves through the clearing.

review.notes: Inspected both native 1920×1080 screenshots: live team lists, HP, ammo, scope and module-hit feedback remain visible; opening includes the real rollout title. The player shell receipt records ricochet with zero damage. Later target destruction is not attributed to this player shot. Encoded motion review is recorded separately. Reviewed nine motion samples across the whole 4.416-second take: convoy advance, scope entry and ricochet card remain legible; no frozen HUD composite or black frames in these samples. The later destroyed-target screenshot is an aftermath image, not a claim that destruction occurs inside the short clip.
